traditional: 令到 A 顯得好細
jyutping: ling6 dou3 A hin2 dak1 hou2 sai3

english.note: Use this construction for the physical or visual sense when something makes another object appear much smaller.

examples.english: The big water tank is big enough to dwarf the flower pot beside it.
examples.traditional: 個大水缸令到旁邊個花盆顯得好細。
examples.jyutping: go3 daai6 seoi2 gong1 ling6 dou3 pong4 bin1 go3 faa1 pun4 hin2 dak1 hou2 sai3
